highlightSections.title: 银海官网航线摘要
highlightSections.content: Fly directly into Antarctica for the adventure of a lifetime. If you’ve dreamed of meeting penguins, cruising past skyscraper-sized icebergs, and experiencing the icy expanse of the world’s most remote continent, this journey is for you. By skipping the long sail south, we’re immediately immersed in Antarctica, ready to explore the Antarctic Sound and Peninsula. Our polar experts will guide you to hidden landings and reveal Antarctica’s most extraordinary wildlife.
